reviews.author: Priya K…
reviews.body: It was my first time getting a tattoo. As you know how scary it can be getting your first because you have to make sure you are in the right hands of professionals. My tattoo artist was Jorge Ramirez. He did such an amazing job on my Polynesian/Melanesian arm band. The best part he was very kind and in answering all my questions and guiding me through the steps. I highly recommend Jorge for your first-time. You will be in trusted hands ✋️. Thank you so much Jorge. Vinaka 🌺💙- Priya

reviews.body: Jorge was awesome and very professional! Super clean shop

reviews.body: Great experience getting our tattoos. Jorge took care of me and 3 of my buddies, very comfortable and friendly environment. Highly recommend if you want something you won’t regret. Very talented artists!
